name: wp-brave-search-engine
description: [ENGINE EXTENSION] The engine classifies search.brave.com (and startpage.com) as organic search. The plugin has no rule for either and treats them as plain referrals.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT: engine -> medium=social..no, medium=organic/channel organic_search; plugin -> source=search.brave.com, medium=referral. Decide if brave/startpage are contract additions in the TS classifier.
